title: Excellent Service
content: I rang to get an appointment as our local walk in centre had closed down and my GP was closed.  A GP called me back within 30 mins after I’d submitted some photos. Got a prescription sent to my local chemist within minutes. This is an excellent service and I highly recommend
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
